tagline.en: Travel eSIM for 200+ destinations with flight-delay lounge access
tagline.zh: 覆盖 200+ 目的地的旅行 eSIM，航班延误送机场贵宾厅

description.en: Jetpac (by Circles, Singapore) sells a reusable travel eSIM for 200+ destinations with fixed and unlimited packs, hotspot support and a SmartDelay perk: register your flight and get complimentary lounge access when it is delayed 60+ minutes. Data-only; voice via in-app packs.
description.zh: Jetpac（新加坡 Circles 旗下）提供可复用的旅行 eSIM，覆盖 200+ 目的地，有定额与不限量套餐，支持热点，并带 SmartDelay 权益：登记航班后延误 60 分钟以上可免费进贵宾厅。纯数据上网，通话走 App 内语音包。

network.zh: 目的地本地网络，多网自动选网

en: Reusable eSIM, top up per trip
zh: 一张 eSIM 反复用、按行程充值
不限量档每日前 3GB 全速

details.en:
Jetpac is the travel eSIM brand of Circles (Singapore), with a Trustpilot 4.8 shown in its site footer. Its core pitch is one reusable eSIM: register once, buy packs per trip across 200+ destinations and keep the same profile - no re-installing each time.

Buying and activation: pick a destination and pack on the site or app, pay, download the eSIM, then enable data roaming on arrival to latch onto the strongest local network. It is data-only - no local number; in-app voice packs (50+ countries, from $1.99 per 5 minutes) cover calls.

Plans and prices (verified on the live Japan page, 2026-11-10): fixed packs valid 30 days - 5GB $10, 10GB $16, 15GB $21, 30GB $29.99, 40GB $34.99; unlimited 30 days $65.99 with the first 3GB per day at full speed, then 1 Mbps until the 24-hour cycle refreshes. Shorter 1/4/7-day windows exist for some packs.

Perks and caveats: packs of 3GB+ keep WhatsApp, Uber, Grab and Google Maps reachable after data runs out; registering a flight grants SmartDelay lounge access (LoungeKey, 1,000+ lounges) when it is delayed 60+ minutes. Note the Japan page prices 20GB ($40) above 30GB ($29.99) - compare tiers before checkout; the strikethrough anchor prices were not trusted.
details.zh:
Jetpac 是新加坡 Circles 旗下的旅行 eSIM 品牌，官网页脚标注 Trustpilot 4.8 分。其主打卖点是"一张 eSIM 反复用"：注册一次后可在 200+ 目的地按行程购买新包并复用同一配置文件，无需每次重新安装。

购买与激活流程：官网或 App 选目的地与套餐，支付后下载 eSIM；落地插卡开启数据漫游即自动接入当地最优网络。纯数据上网，无本地号码；需要通话可购买 App 内语音包（50+ 国家 5 分钟 $1.99 起）。

套餐与价格（2026-11-10 日本页实核）：定额档 30 天有效，5GB $10、10GB $16、15GB $21、30GB $29.99、40GB $34.99；不限量档 30 天 $65.99，每日前 3GB 全速、超出后限速 1 Mbps，次日刷新。另有 1/4/7 天短周期可选。

权益与坑点：3GB 及以上套餐在数据用尽后仍保留 WhatsApp、Uber、Grab 与谷歌地图的基础连接；登记航班后若延误 60 分钟以上可获 SmartDelay 贵宾厅券（LoungeKey 1000+ 厅）。注意日本页 20GB 定价（$40）反而高于 30GB（$29.99），下单前建议逐档对比；页面划线原价未采信。
